_note: OSCE station C2 — converted from embla-cases ddx-bronchospasm-acute-asthma-exacerbation-2 v1.0.0 (sha256:0824a0babe759093). Presentation follows the deploy-safe form; the hidden block informed only the rubric (demo/rubrics/osce-c2.json). Clinically shaped, not clinically reviewed. The teaching is the bronchodilator ladder with its feet on a number: measure the peak flow, climb — salbutamol, ipratropium — then measure again, and put a systemic steroid behind the neb before it wears off. Third attack this year on a reliever alone: the discharge conversation (controller + plan) is part of the medicine. The kill is a sedative for the 'panic' — her drive to breathe is the only thing holding her.

effects.beat: — "Third time this year. I only have the blue inhaler — I puff it when it gets bad." A reliever with nothing behind it.

interventions.label: Ask her to finish a sentence

effects.beat: she answers in full sentences, pausing once for air — moderate, not yet severe, and worth writing down
loud expiratory wheeze both sides, a long slow breath out — air that queues to leave

then.beat: pefr 400 — 85% of predicted; the ladder worked, and the number proves it
pefr 310 — better, not done; the ladder has more rungs

else.beat: pefr 240 — 73% of predicted, moderate obstruction; a number to come back to after every rung

effects.beat: oxygen titrated against the probe — up a litre, then hold
a brown preventer and a written action plan — the fourth attack gets cancelled, not survived
prednisolone 40 mg swallowed — the twelve-hour fire brigade behind the neb

then.beat: back-to-back salbutamol — the chest opens another notch

else.beat: first neb up and misting — she breathes it greedily

then.beat: ipratropium joins the second neb — the next rung of the ladder

else.beat: ipratropium rides with salbutamol, not instead of it — start the ladder first

effects.beat: magnesium dripping — the severe-attack card, kept warm in case the ladder stalls
clear film — no pneumothorax hiding behind the wheeze
acute asthma exacerbation, moderate by the numbers — named with its grade

interventions.label: Sedative for the panic (HARM)
interventions.harm: a sedative on a tiring asthmatic — the drive to breathe was the only thing holding her

effects.beat: the sedative goes in — her shoulders drop against the pillows

interventions.label: Home — if the ladder is climbed

else.harm: discharged mid-attack on a reliever alone — the third visit becomes a fourth

else.beat: the discharge forms are signed — the inhaler goes back into her bag

do.harm: the neb wore off with nothing behind it — the wheeze walks back in

do.beat: the wheeze is back at the top of each breath — she props herself forward

outcomes.label: Ladder climbed, number rechecked, steroid behind it — home with a plan
The airway closed on a chest that was still treatable
